mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM ( SELECT date_sub(a.events_time, INTERVAL 1 DAY) signDate, ( @i := DATE_ADD(@i, INTERVAL - 1 DAY) ) today FROM ( SELECT events_time FROM yh_health_star WHERE user_code = #{userCode} and healthstars_events = #{eventName} ORDER BY events_time DESC ) a INNER JOIN ( SELECT @i := max(events_time) AS signMax FROM yh_health_star WHERE user_code = #{userCode} and healthstars_events = #{eventName} AND ( TO_DAYS(events_time) = TO_DAYS(curdate()) OR TO_DAYS(events_time) = TO_DAYS( DATE_ADD(curdate(), INTERVAL - 1 DAY) ) ) ) b ON b.signMax IS NOT NULL AND TO_DAYS(DATE_ADD(@i, INTERVAL - 1 DAY)) = TO_DAYS( date_sub(a.events_time, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) ) c
select * from yh_health_star as star where star.user_code = #{userCode} and star.healthstars_events=#{eventName} and TO_DAYS( NOW( ) ) - TO_DAYS(star.events_time) <= 1;

select t1.event_type from yh_score_event_category t1 left join yh_health_star t2 on t1.event_name=t2.healthstars_events and t2.user_code=#{userCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where t1.event_type=#{eventType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and DATE_FORMAT( events_time, '%Y%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT( CURDATE( ) ,'%Y%m' ) and `type` = 2 and t1.org_code = (select org_code from yh_user_reginfo where user_code= #{userCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

select t1.event_type from yh_score_event_category t1 left join yh_health_star t2 on t1.event_name=t2.healthstars_events and t2.user_code=#{userCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where t1.event_type=#{eventType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND WEEK(events_time, 1) = WEEK(CURDATE(), 1) AND YEAR(events_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) and `type` = 3 and t1.org_code = (select org_code from yh_user_reginfo where user_code= #{userCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

select t1.event_type from yh_score_event_category t1 left join yh_health_star t2 on t1.event_name=t2.healthstars_events and t2.user_code=#{userCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where t1.event_type=#{eventType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and DATE_FORMAT(t2.events_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y-%m-%d') and `type` = 1 and t1.org_code = (select org_code from yh_user_reginfo where user_code= #{userCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

select t2.* from yh_score_event_category t1 left join yh_health_star t2 on t1.event_name=t2.healthstars_events and t2.user_code=#{userCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where t1.event_type=#{eventType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and DATE_FORMAT(t2.events_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y-%m-%d') and `type` = 1 GROUP BY t2.healthstar_ID limit 1

select reg.user_code as `userCode`,reg.user_name as `usernmae`,reg.name as `name`,str.user_type as `userType`, str.healthstars as `healthstars`,step.healthlevelstars as `healthstarsEvents` from yh_user_reginfo as reg inner join yh_health_star as str on reg.user_code = str.user_code inner join yh_user_step as step on str.user_code = step.user_code where reg.Org_Code like CONCAT('%',#{orgCode},'%') and reg.User_Type=5
AND reg.name like CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')
AND step.healthlevelstars BETWEEN #{priceMin} AND #{priceMax}
group by reg.user_code order by step.healthlevelstars desc

SELECT reg.user_code as userCode, reg.user_name as usernmae, reg.`name`, SUM( IF ( str.user_type = 4, str.healthstars, 0 ) ) AS expenditure, SUM(
IF ( str.user_type = 5, str.healthstars, 0 ) ) AS income, ( SUM(
IF ( str.user_type = 5, str.healthstars, 0 ) ) - SUM(
IF ( str.user_type = 4, str.healthstars, 0 ) ) ) AS healthstarsEvents FROM yh_user_reginfo AS reg LEFT JOIN yh_health_star AS str ON reg.user_code = str.user_code LEFT JOIN yh_user_make_card AS card ON card.User_Code = reg.user_code LEFT JOIN yh_user_admin_info AS yuai ON yuai.id = card.doctor
reg.User_Type=5
and yuai.user_code=#{orgCode} and reg.User_Type=5
and reg.Org_Code like CONCAT('%',#{orgCode1},'%')
AND reg.name like CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')
AND str.events_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY reg.user_code HAVING 1=1
AND healthstarsEvents < #{priceMax}
AND healthstarsEvents > #{priceMin}
ORDER BY healthstarsEvents DESC
